altTitles.en: Even Though I was the Cannon Fodder Character, The People Buzzing when I did Role Play as Protagonist.
A Story of a Cannon Fodder who Firmly Believed He was the Protagonist, Misunderstood the Actual Protagonist as the Cannon Fodder, and Ended up Victorious

description.en: A certain high school boy who admired protagonists from manga and games died while saving a child. At that moment, God appeared and said he would reincarnate him as the protagonist in a visual novel game world. The boy trembled with joy, but that was God's big lie. His reincarnation destination was actually as a pathetically weak stepping-stone character! However, his extraordinary, abnormal efforts based on his delusion of being the protagonist began to drastically rewrite the status of this weak character! This changed the original course of the story, saved beautiful girls, and eventually even saved the world...? The heroic tale of a misunderstanding man who saves the world through sheer conviction!
description.ja:
※この男、主人公ではありません!?

漫画やゲームの主人公に憧れるとある男子高校生は、子どもを救い死んでしまった。
その瞬間神が現れ、ノベルゲー世界の主人公に転生させると言う。
喜びに打ち震えるが、それは神のついた大嘘。
転生先はなんとクソザコ踏み台キャラだった！
しかし彼の常軌を逸した、主人公だという思い込みによる異常な努力は、ザコキャラのステータスを大幅に塗り替えていく！
それは本来の物語のありようを変え、美少女を救い、果ては世界をも救うことに……？
稀代の勘違い男が思い込みだけで世界を救っていく英雄譚！
